messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described camera setup and movement. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in place, turning his head and torso, then briefly raises his right hand to his chest before lowering it.","camera":"A static medium shot from the waist up at eye level.","clothing":"A long-sleeved yellow shirt with a white and orange pattern, red trousers, and a dark belt.","hair_color":"Light brown.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small top-knot bun and faded sides.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short facial hair.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a Ferris wheel on the left and a carousel structure with lights on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output reframes the scene from a full-body side view to a static medium upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. The man is centered, with a Ferris wheel visible on the left and the carousel structure on the right, closely matching the reference first frame. His clothing, hairstyle, action, and apparent timing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle, matching the reference for viewing direction, subject placement, and starting framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Exact preservation of subtle facial expression and action timing cannot be verified frame by frame.
unexpected_changes: The output frames include visible black letterbox bars at the top and bottom, which were not present in the source frames.
